description: Source code for a Notion database document loader component, implementing the INode interface, with methods for initializing and loading documents from Notion API, including metadata handling and text splitting.

classes.name: NotionDB_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a document loader for Notion databases, conforming to the INode interface, capable of loading and processing documents with metadata and optional text splitting.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the NotionDB_DocumentLoaders instance with default properties such as label, name, version, description, inputs, and outputs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously loads documents from Notion API, applies optional text splitting, metadata processing, and returns either document objects or concatenated text based on configuration.
